title: Phase 0: bootstrap repo, toolchain, security baseline
description: git init, .gitignore (excludes .env), Electron+Vite+React19+TS+Tailwind v4 scaffold, Vitest (main/renderer projects), ESLint, Playwright e2e harness, bd init, CLAUDE.md. Security: sandboxed/isolated window, CSP connect-src self, navigation + window-open guards, permission requests denied; copied ipcSecurity/atomicFileWrite/logger from Vangard.
close_reason: Bootstrap complete: npm run gate green (57 unit, 4 e2e)

title: Phase 1: projects and storage
description: Create/open/recent VRS projects (folder: vrs.json, tree.json, docs/*.md, chats/*.json, assets/, bible/*.json, maps/). Schema versioning + migrations. Path-guarded fs IPC (validateProjectPath + atomicWriteFile), vetted project roots via dialog. Save + dirty tracking, crash-recovery snapshots, external-change watcher. Storage layer takes a root so a shared library can come later.
notes: Plan: main-process modules in electron/lib (projectSchema = versioning+migrations, projectStore = create/open/readDoc/save with atomic writes, write order docs->tree->vrs.json and deletes last; recentProjects in userData; recoveryStore = per-project snapshot in userData/recovery; projectWatcher = fs.watch recursive, self-writes filtered by content hash). Vetted roots: current project root is only ever set from a dialog result or an entry in the recents list (which only dialog results populate). IPC project:* + dialog for unsaved prompts. Renderer: pure project reducer + useProject hook, Welcome screen (new/open/recent), minimal stand-in project view (doc list + plain editor) until Phase 2 ports the binder. E2E: VRS_USER_DATA_DIR env override; dialogs stubbed via electronApp.evaluate. Tests: unit for each lib module + reducer, component tests for welcome/project view, e2e create->save->relaunch->persist and external edit pickup.
close_reason: Projects and storage done: schema+migrations, vetted roots, atomic ordered saves, dirty tracking, crash recovery, external-change watcher. Gate green (193 unit, 9 e2e).

title: VRS v1: standalone research studio + story bible
description: Standalone Electron app: research workspace (ported from the Scrivener Research Studio prototype at C:/Users/ghirp/Downloads/Test/scrivener-research-studio) + manual story bible with route-scoped canon and conflict detection. AI strictly opt-in (explicit enable + API key). No code shared with bmf-vangard-renpy-ide or bmf-vangard-vnstorybible; copying from Vangard is allowed. Vangard bridge is out of scope (planned separately).

title: Phase 4: opt-in AI layer and chat
description: Settings -> AI: off by default; enable requires provider + API key + successful test. Key in safeStorage, never sent to renderer. Main-process provider interface; Gemini over REST first (streaming, models listed from API, cancel). llm:* handlers refuse while disabled; AI UI hidden while disabled. Port ChatDocumentEditor with canon-context injection.
notes: From Phase 2: when porting ChatDocumentEditor, mount it with key={item.id} (the prototype reused one instance across chat items, leaking messages/draft state). Store transcripts as chats/<id>.json and extend useProject's external-change handler for chats/ (assets/ is already handled). Add the AI Chat type to ITEM_TYPES/AddItemModal only while AI is enabled.

title: Phase 5: AI extraction to proposals
description: Spike: what Gemini web chats can export (Takeout/share links/copy-paste). Chunked extraction (Gemini structured JSON) -> proposed facts with evidence into a review queue; nothing auto-canon. Content-hash cache; rejected decisions sticky. Bounded, user-triggered semantic conflict check.

title: Phase 2: port prototype workspace
description: Port binder, document editor (DOMPurify-sanitized markdown preview), inspector, outliner, corkboard, split pane, QuickRef, Markdown dossier export. Media import via main-process handler (destination computed in main), real audio playback, shell.openExternal for web clips. Theme tokens (light/dark). Remove Scrivener branding, server.ts, localStorage, data URLs, Google Fonts. Fix prototype bugs: chat editor not keyed by item id, stale AddItemModal defaults, stale QuickRef snapshot, duplicate ignores descendants/id collisions, denormalized reference titles, split-pane divider, per-keystroke whole-list rewrites.
notes: From Phase 1: replace src/components/ProjectWorkspace.tsx (stand-in) with the ported binder/editor; keep using useProject (src/project). The external-change handler in useProject only reacts to docs/*.md, tree.json and vrs.json -- extend it for chats/ and assets/ when those item types land. Media import must go through a main-process handler that writes under the session root.

title: Phase 3: manual story bible (no AI)
description: Entities (character, location, faction, item, lore, event, scene, plotline) + wiki pages; structured facts with provenance; routes; route-scoped canon status (proposed/canon/alternate/rejected). Deterministic conflict detection (same entity+attribute, overlapping routes, different value) and conflict queue with side-by-side sources. Timeline + plot/scene outline views. Story-bible Markdown export. Transcript import (paste/file) as read-only sources -- not an AI feature.

title: Persisted theme preference (system/light/dark)
description: Phase 2 tokenised every color and follows the OS theme; index.css already supports :root[data-theme]. Add an app-settings store in userData (no localStorage) and a toggle, likely alongside the Phase 4 Settings screen.

title: Stream large media assets instead of reading them whole
description: project:read-asset returns the whole file over IPC and the renderer wraps it in a blob: URL (import cap 512 MB). For long audio, serve assets through a privileged custom protocol with range requests (and add it to the CSP media-src/img-src), keeping the vetted-root path checks.

title: PDF research items
description: The prototype had a 'pdf' item type that Phase 2 did not port. Needs: import (extend MEDIA_KINDS), a viewer that works under the CSP (frame-src 'none' today -- consider pdf.js rendering to canvas, or 'Open in default app' via shell.openPath on a validated asset path).

title: Decide: copy/paste 'bring your own AI' mode
description: VRS generates prompts the user runs in Gemini web and pastes results back (no API key). Open question: is it gated behind the AI opt-in (which currently requires an API key), or dropped? Needed before Phase 5.

title: Phase 6: Map Studio
description: Port fantasyMapGenerator.ts + FantasyMapStudio UI; maps saved as maps/<id>.json, rendered PNG into assets/, attachable to location entities.
notes: From Phase 2: save rendered maps through the existing asset path (assets/<id>.png + item.asset); image items already display, zoom, and delete assets safely via deletedAssets.

title: Phase 7: distribution
description: electron-builder installers, code signing, auto-update, release workflow, app icon.
